dct_title_s: Old Map of the Continent according to the greatest diametrical Length from the Point of Eaſt Tartary to the Cape of Good Hope
dct_description_sm: Appears in: Gentleman's Magazine or Monthly Intelligence, vol. 1, 1731. London, F. Jeffery.
Map includes Europe, Asia and the Far East. The oval-shaped cartouche contains a floral border with a female face wearing a wide-brimmed hat.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0081, p. 96
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Map of Africa no. MOA0030.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0081.
